tagline: Regional utility delivering reliable energy to Pacific Northwest communities
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'Regulatory Assets' KPI is the primary driver because it reflects deferred costs awaiting recovery through regulated rates, a key element of cash flow and profitability dynamics in a business model heavily regulated by federal and state commissions.

kpis.name: Regulatory Assets
kpis.explanation: Deferred costs carried on the balance sheet that the company expects to recover through future rates.
kpis.description: Regulatory assets are increasing as the company invests in infrastructure where returns are subject to regulatory approval.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves with utility revenues at $1,963 million in 2025 and operating expenses at $1,610 million.
kpis.signal: Expanding margin driven by cost optimization

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual investments in distribution infrastructure and grid modernization.
kpis.description: Capex is rising to enhance grid reliability, address climate risks, and upgrade infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Higher capex for electric and gas grid modernization

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time equivalent employees.
kpis.description: Headcount is slightly increasing to support growth in capital investments and distribution operations.
kpis.signal: Growing workforce to support expanded operations

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net income for the period.
kpis.description: Net income increases to $193 million in 2025 compared to $180 million in 2024, reflecting operational improvement.
kpis.signal: Profitability growing, supported by revenue and cost control

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $1.964 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.354 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $2.38 in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations from five commissions (Washington, Idaho, Oregon, Montana, Alaska), which may impact its operations and cost recovery.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces operational risks such as outages, natural disasters, and fire events. Emergency plans and operational centers are in place.

risks.title: Climate Change Risk
risks.score_rationale: Climate change affects energy demand, regulation, and exposes assets to increased risks from natural disasters.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks affecting critical energy infrastructure systems.

risks.title: Financial Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates (interest expense of $152 million in 2025) and energy prices.

risks.title: Customer Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks of payment defaults from residential and commercial customers, although mitigated by regulatory frameworks.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company finances its capital investments ($685 million in 2025) through debt instruments sensitive to interest rate changes.

ai_positioning.summary: The company AVA does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K filing.
